system.description:
Favoured weapon: Club

Granted power: Tenet: Stand firm, and keep your word as you'd keep a foundation.

  • While you stand on natural stone or earth, you can't be pushed or knocked Prone against your will.
  • When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, the ground within 20ft of you becomes difficult terrain for your enemies until your next turn.

Allegiance: True Neutral, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Grumbar in the World of Arneyan wiki.
